title: Glow Cards
description: A grid of cards whose borders light up where the cursor passes — only the border glows.
usage: For feature grids that need life without noise: at rest the cards are plain catalog cards, and only the border near the cursor warms. The script tracks the pointer per card and feeds two custom properties; the frame does the rest with a masked radial gradient.
a11y: The glow is a border treatment on cards that read perfectly without it — no information rides on the light. It follows the pointer only, so keyboard and touch users lose nothing, and it is off under prefers-reduced-motion.
